theatres.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
theatres.review: Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn't remember him—and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him—sparks a change in…
theatres.fullReview: Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn't remember him—and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him—sparks a change in Peter Parker he may not have the power to control. But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves - a powerful villain no one can even see.
theatres.take: Mostly good reviews — the performances and direction impressed, even if the pacing didn't.

theatres.title: The Odyssey
theatres.review: Odysseus, the legendary King of Ithaca, embarks on a long and perilous journey home following the Trojan War.

similar.title: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring

theatres.fullReview: Odysseus, the legendary King of Ithaca, embarks on a long and perilous journey home following the Trojan War. Throughout his voyage, he is forced to confront the whims of gods, mythological monsters, and trials that stretch both his cunning and his humanity to the breaking point.
theatres.take: Viewer word on TMDB runs mixed — reviews keep coming back to the performances.

theatres.title: Was haben wir gelacht
theatres.review: An entire generation of Germans was raised on male comedians. But what about their female counterparts?
theatres.fullReview: An entire generation of Germans was raised on male comedians. But what about their female counterparts? Maren Kroymann, Hella von Sinnen, Bettina Böttinger, Esther Schweins, and Gaby Köster look back at the way women were portrayed on TV in the 1990s and early 2000s, when jokes at women’s expense were the order of the day.

Tinker Bell and the Lost Treasure

theatres.fullReview: When Bonnie receives a Lilypad tablet as a gift and becomes obsessed, Buzz, Woody, Jessie and the rest of the gang's jobs become exponentially harder when they have to go head to head with the all-new threat to playtime.
theatres.take: Reviews lean positive: strong marks for the performances and humour, quibbles about the writing.

theatres.title: Kraken
theatres.review: A marine biologist is doing research on a fish farm when she encounters several strange occurrences.
theatres.fullReview: A marine biologist is doing research on a fish farm when she encounters several strange occurrences. Along with the brutal deaths of two teenagers, all signs point to the deep fjord; can there be more to the depths than the eye can see?

theatres.title: The Invite
theatres.review: Joe and Angela’s marriage is on thin ice. When they invite their enigmatic upstairs neighbors for a dinner party, the night spirals into unexpected places.
theatres.fullReview: Joe and Angela’s marriage is on thin ice. When they invite their enigmatic upstairs neighbors for a dinner party, the night spirals into unexpected places. Have they reignited the spark or lit the match that burns it all down?
theatres.take: Wall-to-wall praise from the critics on this one.
theatres.hook: A remake of the Spanish film ‘The People Upstairs’.

theatres.title: Soulm8te
theatres.review: After a ruthless tech giant acquires a small robotics company, a grieving engineer is tasked with testing their new AI companion.
theatres.fullReview: After a ruthless tech giant acquires a small robotics company, a grieving engineer is tasked with testing their new AI companion. But when he attempts to reprogram her to be a truly sentient soulmate, she develops needs of her own—unleashing a relentless spree of precision-engineered mayhem.
theatres.hook: Premiered at the Gaze International LGBT Film Festival.

ott.title: Lioness
ott.review: Cruz Manuelos, a rough-around-the-edges but passionate young Marine, is recruited to join the CIA's Lioness Engagement Team to help bring down a terrorist…
ott.fullReview: Cruz Manuelos, a rough-around-the-edges but passionate young Marine, is recruited to join the CIA's Lioness Engagement Team to help bring down a terrorist organization from within. Joe, the station chief of the Lioness program, is tasked with training, managing and leading her female undercover operatives.
ott.take: Critics can't agree — high marks for the performances and visuals, complaints about the story.
ott.takeCounter: Viewers beg to differ — audience scores run well above the critics' line.

ott.fullReview: A group of college friends' Thailand adventure turns deadly when they become trapped in submerged caves with a dangerous predator. As oxygen runs low, past conflicts emerge in their desperate fight for survival.
ott.take: Critics are split clean down the middle on this one.

ott.title: The Devil Wears Prada 2
ott.review: Andy Sachs returns to Runway as Miranda Priestly navigates a new media landscape and Runway's position within.
ott.fullReview: Andy Sachs returns to Runway as Miranda Priestly navigates a new media landscape and Runway's position within. The duo reconnect with former assistant Emily Charlton, now the head of a luxury brand that possesses funding which could ensure Runway's survival.
ott.hook: The follow-up to ‘The Devil Wears Prada’.

ott.fullReview: Maggie and Negan travel to post-apocalyptic Manhattan - long ago cut off from the mainland. The crumbling city is filled with the dead and denizens who have made it a world full of anarchy, danger, beauty, and terror.
ott.take: Critics are split clean down the middle on this one.
ott.takeCounter: Audiences disagree — viewers rate it far higher.
ott.hook: The follow-up to ‘The Walking Dead television series’.

ott.title: Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender
ott.review: Avatar Aang, the world's last Airbender, learns of an ancient power that could save his culture from extinction.

similar.title: The SpongeBob Movie: Sponge on the Run
Chickenhare and the Hamster of Darkness
Ramayana : The Legend of Prince Rama

ott.fullReview: Avatar Aang, the world's last Airbender, learns of an ancient power that could save his culture from extinction. With the help of his friends, he embarks on a global quest to find it before it falls into the wrong hands and threatens to upend the peace they sacrificed everything to achieve.
ott.take: Broadly positive reviews, though the originality drew grumbles.

ott.title: Masters of the Universe
ott.review: After being separated for 15 years, the Sword of Power leads Prince Adam back to Eternia, where he discovers his home shattered under the fiendish rule of…

similar.title: Star Wars: Episode III - Revenge of the Sith

ott.fullReview: After being separated for 15 years, the Sword of Power leads Prince Adam back to Eternia, where he discovers his home shattered under the fiendish rule of Skeletor. To save his family and his world, Adam must join forces with his closest allies, Teela and Duncan/Man-At-Arms, and embrace his true destiny as He-Man — the most powerful man in the universe.
ott.take: Opinion is split — the performances and first half is the bright spot either way.

ott.title: House of the Dragon
ott.review: The Targaryen dynasty is at the absolute apex of its power, with more than 15 dragons under their yoke. Most empires crumble from such heights.
ott.fullReview: The Targaryen dynasty is at the absolute apex of its power, with more than 15 dragons under their yoke. Most empires crumble from such heights. In the case of the Targaryens, their slow fall begins when King Viserys breaks with a century of tradition by naming his daughter Rhaenyra heir to the Iron Throne. But when Viserys later fathers a son, the court is shocked when Rhaenyra retains her status as his heir, and seeds of division sow friction across the realm.
ott.take: Reviewers found plenty to like here.

similar.title: The Man in the High Castle

ott.fullReview: In a ruined and toxic future, thousands live in a giant silo deep underground. After its sheriff breaks a cardinal rule and residents die mysteriously, engineer Juliette starts to uncover shocking secrets and the truth about the silo.
ott.take: Critics were won over, largely on the strength of the performances and production design.

ott.fullReview: Follow Captain Christopher Pike, Science Officer Spock and Number One in the years before Captain Kirk boarded the U.S.S. Enterprise, as they explore new worlds around the galaxy.
ott.take: Mostly good reviews — the performances and production design impressed, even if the tone didn't.

ott.fullReview: The X-Men, a band of mutants who use their uncanny gifts to protect a world that hates and fears them, are challenged like never before, forced to face a dangerous and unexpected new future.
ott.take: Critics loved this one, and the writing and action drew the loudest praise.
